**A143. The passive end-range stiffness** (the lead, 2026-09-30 20:15; a body change on branch t157, C162; lands at the next 1,000-tick save)
- **What:** in the last 15% of a joint's range, at either end, the body's passive tissues push back toward the middle, rising linearly from nothing at the margin to the joint's torque limit at the stop (world.passive_torque, applied to the joints each physics step through qfrc_applied; PASSIVE_FRAC 1.0 since C163 the same evening, 0.2 as first landed; the hand's joints left out). Over the middle 70% of the range nothing changes. The push is the tissue's, not the motor's: it is never read as gear load, so it is never pain, and it does not heat the motor.
- **Why:** day 43's record with the stop masks (C160, C161): the body lay folded into its range limits, 6.5 of the 14 arm joints at a stop on average, the knees, the waist and three hip joints too. The resting target follows the measured angle (3.3's tone) and the act's target is clipped to the range, so once gravity or the floor presses a joint to its stop nothing brings it back. A joint at a stop shows its inverse model nothing of its acts (the stop-bound joints' kappa 0.07 to 0.19 against 0.66 to 0.74 for the free ones), so its readout stays flat (C148) and it draws big steps at random (37% at a stop against 5 to 10% off it); and the pain rate falls as more joints freeze, so the body learned to freeze. A body that cannot leave its stops cannot learn what its joints do.
- **Biology and the robot:** passive elastic joint moments are near zero over the middle of the range and rise steeply toward its ends (Riener and Edrich 1999, the lower limbs; the same form at the arm); a newborn lying prone holds its limbs in physiological flexion, not at the anatomical limits. A real G1 is driven inside software position limits with a margin; a controller that parks joints on their mechanical stops is a fault on the real robot too. The two constants are ours, disclosed; the margin and the fraction are to be read on the stops ruler within the hour of landing (occupancy under 30% is the mark) and the pain rate with it.
- **C163, the fraction raised to 1.0 (20:30):** at 0.2 the first 1,400 ticks moved the arm joints at a stop from 5.7 to 4.2 of 14 and the pain from 20.5 to 12.6 a thousand, but the left wrist roll stayed pinned 92% of ticks, drawing big steps 56% of the time: its flat readout commands steps into the stop, the act's target is clipped at the range end, and the motor pushes in at 3 Nm against the tissue's 4.9, so the joint sits 0.01 rad from the hard stop and every act there is still blind. With the push equal to the motor's limit at the stop no drive reaches the hard stop: under full drive the joint settles where kp x (stop - q) meets the push, about 0.17 rad inside (kp = the limit over 0.25 rad), where every step still moves it and the gear load stays under the pain line. An infant's muscles cannot push a joint past its anatomical limit against the tissue: the ratio is the infant's, the number ours. The hand's joints are left out: a stiff spring on their tiny inertia would need a finer physics step, and the fingers were never the problem.

**A139. The tendon organ: autogenic inhibition at the spinal cord** (the lead, 2026-09-28 22:10; a body change on branch a139, for dawn 28; C113 answered)
- **Why:** day 26's morning (C113): 436 pain ticks at the right elbow between ticks 500 and 1,500, the child on its back. The dawn-27 pair lived again on a copy with the life's four threads reproduced it exactly (pain per 500 ticks 51, 245, 209, 0 against the life's 59, 244, 210, 3; a two-thread copy did not: the unrolling differs by thread count, as the pins say). The probe (`--probe-joint 13`): from tick 768 to 1,208 the elbow sat at −0.63 rad, no stop within 0.4 rad, its servo target one big step (0.27 rad) further into flexion every tick, its torque saturated at the 25 N m line, the gear's sensed peak at the line: the pain flag. The withdrawal reflex (3.7) fires a big flexion step on a limb in pain; the arm could not move (its forearm against the mat under the body's roll); the blocked step overloaded the gear; the overload IS this body's pain; the pain fired the step again: a loop the reflex feeds itself, 440 ticks, ended only when the body shifted. The same family as C104's dawn storms (the record's joint 10 is the right shoulder pitch, not an ankle), C109's prone elbow and day 25's right wrist yaw: every pain storm on record is a joint pushed by its own reflex or actor into a load it cannot move.
- **Built:** `body/sim/reflexes.py` `tendon(steps, loaded, state, joints_of)`, TENDON_TICKS 2 (ours, as WITHDRAW_TICKS): a joint whose sensed gear load reached its line last tick (the pain flag's own afferent: the Golgi tendon organ's Ib, which inhibits the motor neurons of the muscle whose tension is excessive, Houk and Henneman 1967) has its step zeroed for TENDON_TICKS ticks, its servo target re-anchored to its angle (the drive relaxed), over the own act, the cord's step and the withdrawal alike; its neighbours move; the truth's spinal says "tendon" per effector; no gate eligibility moves (the own act stays the gate's, as the grasp leaves it; the cortex sees the relaxed joint through its joint sense and the forward error). `body/sim/world.py` `apply`: the hook after the steps are read and before the targets are set (with `self.spinal`); the countdown `_tendon` saved and restored with the world (older saves: zeros); `eff_joint_idx`.
- **Measured:** world 35 `test_the_tendon_organ` (the loaded elbow's target its angle for two ticks, the shoulder stepping, then free; under the line untouched). The storm copy with the reflex (the dawn-27 pair's first 1,600 ticks, four threads): 22 pain ticks against 505, no elbow pain, 22 cries against 500, 13 judged acts against 8, reward −10 against −496; the trajectory parts from the storm's at the first loaded tick, so the count is the reflex's shape (a load at the line lasts one tick), not a like-for-like of the same body's day.
- **Boundary:** a born reflex of the cord (3.7's family), a body change: the born digests move, re-pinned with the note. In at dawn 28 (the owner's word: everything in as built).

**A137. The inner word** (the lead, 2026-09-28 18:20; a switch of the body, for dawn 29)
- **Why:** the owner asked whether the held word (A130) is an inner monologue. It is not: only a word the voice SOUNDS is held. Inner speech grows out of speech to oneself as the articulators are stilled (Vygotsky; children of five to seven), and the voice here already chooses a word every tick and lets its gate decide whether to sound it: the unsounded choice is the inner word, and holding it needs no new organ.
- **Built:** `body/core/mouth.py` records the voice's top choice and its probability every tick (`_last_choice` "top", "p_top"); `body/core/frames.py` `_goal_trace`: with `inner_speech` on, a tick with no sounded word holds the voice's top choice when it was sure of it (p_top at least INNER_P), exactly as a said word is held (the same trace, the same key), counting them (`_inner_n`), and `_frame_tick` gives the frame's value the inner word's efference copy as it gives a said word's (imagined speech remembered: the plan made, the sound withheld, Tian and Poeppel 2010); `body/core/memory.py` INNER_P 0.5 (the word likelier than every other together: ours); `physiology.py` `inner_speech` 0; `SIM_CFG` 1 from dawn 29; the runner's record carries `covert`, the inner word of the tick, and `speech_act_reading.py --covert` reads P(an act on the toy | its inner word named it).
- **Measured:** world 33 `test_the_inner_word`: a sure unsounded choice is held (the key toward its row), an unsure one is not, a said word is held as before; the inner word enters the frame's value as a said word's copy does; with the switch off no unsounded word is held; a life of 40 ticks with it on held 7 inner words (INNER_P 0.5). The pins re-taken (a born body with inner words).
- **What it is not:** the predicted sound of the inner word reaching its own ear (the second half of imagined speech), and a chain of inner words planning ahead. Those are the steps after, and the second is not small.
- **Boundary:** a body change at dawn 29 (with A136, the turn), the pins re-taken.

**C110, the frames' events rarely end under a live parent** (the lead, 2026-09-28 18:57): a copy of the dawn-26 pair run 1,500 ticks by the runner, the parent talking and moving, ended no frame event (the settle law, the surprise's fast average at or under half its slow one, R7's offset_settle 0.5); the same pair run 300 ticks with the parent still ended 4. **A138. Waking imagination** (the lead, 2026-09-28 18:45; a switch of the body, two switches; the last architectural piece of the sprint)
- **Why:** the owner asked for imagination beyond words, and for the architecture to be whole. The body imagined only asleep (REM's free run of the stream over its frames, R8b, with its limbs since A132) and, awake, one step ahead (the forecast heads) or by recall (a recalled frame's codes). It never ran its own model forward before acting. The hippocampus does: the forward sweep of place-cell sequences at a choice point (Johnson and Redish 2007), the prefrontal evaluation of what the sweep shows, and the striatum's choice under it.
- **Built:** `body/core/sleep.py` `_rollout`: REM's free run of the stream (the words drawn, every vector channel's code its head's forecast, the limbs' imagined acts under rem_limbs) made one machinery for the night and the day (`_rem_frames` calls it; night 4 and 5 unchanged); `_imagine`, called at every frame-event's end (`_frame_end`, the body's natural pause): the stream run free from the tape's last IMAG_SEED rows (3, REM's k) for rem_steps positions, no learning; two things kept of it, both fading with GOAL_TAU: `_imag`, the unit direction of the imagined frames' mean value (their codes and efference copies), joining the recall key at IMAG_SCALE (`memory.query_from`, imagine_key: what it recalls into its acts is conditioned on where it is about to be), and `_imag_N`, the amygdala's forecast on the imagined states (its reliable heads' anticipated good less bad, `(x @ W)+`, no learning), joining the gates' approach-and-avoid bias as the felt forecast does under amyg_pav's earned form (`mouth._choose_effector`, imagine_pav: a go toward an imagined good, a freeze before an imagined bad). `_tape_tail` reads the seed from the day's tape. Three triggers, since the first alone never fires under a live parent (C110): an event's end (`_frame_end`); a pause of IMAG_PAUSE ticks (10, 1.5 s) with every motor effector at rest, once per pause (`_imagine_pause`; the moment an animal deliberates, Redish 2016's vicarious trial and error), which the live body's ever-acting arms never gave in 1,500 ticks either; and every frame the store keeps as new (`_frame_write`, about a tenth of ticks): the mismatch that drives dopamine drives the forward sweep too (a surprising moment is when to look ahead). The record carries `ends`, the day's event ends, and `imag`, the imaginings. The night lets both go. `physiology.py` imagine_key, imagine_pav 0; `SIM_CFG` both 1 from their dawn; the record carries `imag` (the count) and `imag_N`.
- **Measured:** world 34 `test_waking_imagination`: a life of 60 ticks with both switches on imagines once at a forced event's end, holds a unit future, and its key with the future held lies at cosine 0.822 to the same key without it; the imagined valence 0.0 on a newborn amygdala; with both off nothing is imagined and the key is unmoved; the night lets the future go. Night 4 and 5 unchanged by the shared rollout. On a copy of the dawn-26 pair run 1,500 ticks by the runner (two threads, beside the life and a suite): 175 imaginings (12% of ticks), 14 event ends where the copies without imagination had none, the imagined valence -0.39 at the end; a tick with an imagining 513 ms against 333 without (the rollout's 11 stream steps at d 512), about 6% on the day; that copy hurt itself 42 ticks where the two earlier copies of the same pair hurt 76 each, and was judged 11 times: one copy, a sign and not a reading.
- **Constants:** IMAG_SEED 3 (REM's own k), IMAG_SCALE 1.0 (R7f's equal weight; ours), IMAG_PAUSE 10 ticks (ours); the horizon rem_steps; the fade GOAL_TAU; the bias's beta and clip amyg_pav's.
- **Boundary:** a body change at a dawn after body B's two-day reading (dawn 32 or 33); the pins re-taken.

**A129. The hide game: object permanence's ruler proper** (the lead, 2026-09-28 14:10; a teacher change, on A126)
- **Why:** Piaget's stage-4 test (8 to 12 months): an object hidden in full view of the infant, and the infant's reach to where it went. Her acts had no hiding; the child's search had no occasion. With the bucket in the room she can put a toy into it before the child's eyes, and the child's hand into the bucket after is the find. The body's side is A128 (the held context) and A130 (the held word); this is the environment's and the teacher's.

(the focus "bucket", the room's newest word) and "look. in the bucket. the {o}."; OPEN_CONTAINERS {"bucket"}: a thing "in the bucket" is a claim she can check (its `on`), every other "in" stays containment she cannot see; `dayplan.py`: the hide game is every other lesson on a toy the child grasps at will (got at 2 x MASTERED_N; the handle and give rungs between) when she sees the bucket.

Lang 62 `test_the_hide_line`: "the duck is in the bucket." passes of a duck seen in the bucket, "not true" of one on the mat, "in the box" stays containment. Lane 18 `test_the_find`: the duck let go into the bucket from her hand is hidden and seen `on` "bucket"; its own hand on it is "found", worth 2, and it is hidden no more; a duck in the bucket by no hand of hers is not hidden and its grasp is no find; a hidden toy out of the bucket with no hand on it for HIDDEN_OUT_TICKS (10, 1.5 s: the lane's reading of a hold takes GOT_HOLD ticks to settle; ours) is hidden no more.

**A132. The limbs dream: imagination for the body** (the lead, 2026-09-28 14:20; the brain sprint's fourth body piece; a switch of the body)
- **Why:** own goals need a horizon longer than a tick, and the body's forward model (act_pred, the forecast heads) learns only from what it did. Biology rehearses in sleep: in REM the motor cortex fires as in waking movement while the spinal cord holds the muscles still (Jouvet 1965's atonia; the twitches that leak through are R8c's), and motor skill consolidates over the night. In this body's REM over frames (R8b) the cortex ran free with every effector at rest: the dream had no acts, so the forecast heads never learned what follows an act it only imagined.
- **Built:** `body/core/sleep.py` `_rem_limb_act`: a motor effector's imagined act on the free-running stream, act_pred's proposal read out joint by joint at its earned sharpness and drawn at the REM temperature (its best guess at temperature 0), with no gate, no striatal bias and no orienting bias; `_rem_frames` with `rem_limbs` on: the seed positions carry the day's own acts from the tape (`a`), and along the free run each effector's act is its imagined one, an efference copy in the dream's inputs; the night reports `rem_limb_acts` (the imagined acts not at rest). `body/core/physiology.py` `rem_limbs` 0; `SIM_CFG` 1 from dawn 25.
- **Measured:** night 5 `test_the_limbs_dream` (test_night.py): on the G1's day of 300 ticks and its night of 12 dreams (REM 4 dreams of 4 free steps a round), 863 of the 864 acts drawn along the free runs were not rest, counted as the night reports them, the REM loss finite (cos -0.013); with the switch off none are drawn and the report says 0 (12 dreams, cos -0.026). The sim's digests move with the default on (the born night dreams differently); re-pinned.
- **The rulers:** the days' judged acts and pain (a body that rehearses its acts in sleep should act more surely by day), the re-grasp and re-find readings, the film.
- **Boundary:** a body change at a dawn (dawn 25, with the bucket and the hide game: the all-in sprint).

**A133. The changed room: the environment generalization ruler** (the lead, 2026-09-28 14:35; an environment change and an instrument)
- **Why:** the owner's word on generalization (2026-09-28): the understanding of the environment, not of other robots. A child who knows the ball knows it on the other side of the room; a parent who knows the sofa finds it where the family moved it. Until now the room had one layout and her motion carried the furniture's places as constants (parent_motion.FIXTURES, SOFA_SPOT): nothing could test whether what the body knows survives a move.
- **Built:** `body/sim/make_g1room.py` LAYOUTS: "a" the room of birth; "b" the same room with its furniture moved as a family moves it (the sofa slid along the back wall to the left, x .15 to -1.0; the low table to the right, just north of the mat, (.15, .95) to (.9, .62), clear of the drum's birth spot; the lamp and the big plant across the room; the wall art follows the sofa), the mat, the toys, the shelves, the window and the door as they were; `room(layout)`, `scene_xml(folder, layout)`, `--layout=b --out=body/sim/g1room_b.xml` writes the changed room (the room of birth regenerates byte for byte). `body/sim/g1scene.py` XML_B, ROOMS; `G1World(xml=)`; `tools/sim_life.py --room a|b`; `tools/sim_migrate_world.py build(room=)`. `body/sim/parent_motion.py` `fixtures_of(m)`: the sofa's, the table's, the shelf's and the lamp's places from the model's geoms (the lamp's shade named for it) (the door, the hall, the window, the light and the mat the walls'), SOFA_SPOT_OFF her seat from the sofa's centre: what she looks at, points at, walks to and sits on follows the furniture (the room of birth reproduces the old constants exactly).
- **Measured:** world 31 `test_the_changed_room`: room b has the same joints, actuators and bodies; the sofa at x -1.00 (birth 0.15), the table at (0.90, 0.62), her seat at (-0.29, 1.64); the ten toys born where they were; a room-a world of 30 ticks loads and lives on; the lane's fixtures the same six words; the cup put under the moved table is tidied 1.37 m back to its birth place. Parent 29 `test_her_way_in_the_changed_room`: her show of the duck to a seated child done in room b, and her walk to the sofa seats her at the moved sofa's spot (room a: (0.86, 1.64)).
- **What the move broke, fixed:** her lesson's put read its place from the child's near hand where she planned from, not where she knelt; when the child lay down on its front during her fetch, the place moved before its face and her release landed 45 to 67 cm off (the A125 landing check refused it). Now `_act_bring_back` asks the approach for a spot from which her hand reaches the put's place (`_need_ok` "reach:x,y", from her heels, as a put reaches), `_plan_put_near` re-kneels once when the place is out of reach from where she is (at a prone child's head, A125's), and the landing check belongs to the lesson's puts alone (`_put_phases(check=True)`; a toy set aside or cleared from her way lands where it lands: the ring set aside 25 cm off had refused a bring-back).
- **What the move broke, found and fixed (C108, 16:17):** the bring-back in room b to a child that topples onto its front mid-fetch ended in the jump guard (forearm_L 0.62 m in a tick, phase relax). The rig (`c108_rig.py`) and an instrumented `_place` showed the mechanism: at the relax's fifth tick her left elbow's swing leapt from +120 to -60 degrees. In `_place`'s far-elbow branch (the natural pole's elbow far from the drawn one: the hand had been drawn up and back after the set-aside, the elbow up at swivel 120) every candidate swing's elbow was compared against the elbow AS DRAWN A TICK AGO, at last tick's wrist and shoulder; once the relax had moved the wrist 9 cm and the trunk 6 degrees, every swing looked like a jump over MAX_JUMP_M, the key fell through to the range excess, and the natural pose 180 degrees away won. Now a second measure of continuity joins the first, like with like: the elbow her last swing gives at THIS tick's wrist and shoulder, and a swing continuous with EITHER the drawn elbow or that one counts as continuous (the jump is the smaller of the two). A first cut that replaced the drawn elbow's measure by the last swing's alone locked her elbow to its last swing where the old measure had a good option and lost two reach tests (parent 12's turn: her hands 22 cm off; parent 13's getting up); with both measures every parent test passes. Parent 29 does the bring-back in room b in 348 ticks (the fetch, the re-kneel at the toppled child's head, the ring cleared, the put); parent 27 (the prone put, 207 and 346 ticks) and 28 (the hide, 174 ticks) unchanged; the room-a bring-back 139 ticks as before. A108's kind of fault (the way back from a plan her body is not in), the second of its family.
- **The ruler:** at a dawn after the body has lived with the tub, the life's saved pair carried into room b (`--room b`): the day read against the day before with the same rulers (judged acts, toys reached, re-grasps, re-finds, her asks met, the hide game, pain, her smiles seen); a body that generalizes the environment keeps its numbers; the parent's refusals (`day_reading.py`) show what of hers the move broke. The move back (`--room a`) the day after is the second reading.
- **Boundary:** an environment change at a dawn (planned for dawn 27 or later, after two days with the tub); a two-day reading.

**A134. The changed body: the pre-robot rehearsal** (the lead, 2026-09-28 14:50; an instrument)
- **Why:** the owner's word: the body change is the rehearsal for the real robot, not the headline. A brain that is body-general (the user's goal) keeps learning when its limbs are not the ones it grew in: a real G1's arm is not the simulated one's to the centimetre, its links not to the hundred grams. Until now there was one body and no way to ask.
- **Built:** `body/sim/make_g1room.py` `body_variant("b")`: the stock G1's XML rewritten by exact substitutions into `assets/unitree_g1/g1_with_hands_b.xml`: the forearms a fifth longer (the wrist roll link 0.12 m out from the elbow, was 0.10), the shanks a tenth longer (the ankle 0.33 m below the knee, was 0.30), the elbow and knee links three tenths heavier (BODY_B); the joints, their ranges and their torques as they were, so a saved life loads on it; the meshes the stock ones (a forearm's collision mesh ends 2 cm short of its wrist). `scene_xml(folder, layout, body)`, `--body=b --out=body/sim/g1room_body_b.xml`; `g1scene.py` XML_BODY_B, SCENES, `scene_path(room, body)` (the room and the body change one at a time: no scene for both); `tools/sim_life.py --body a|b`; the migration's `build(body=)`. Her reading of the child's arm (`Child.arm_m`) and the lane's reach (`arm_reach`) come from the model already, so they follow the body.
- **Measured:** world 32 `test_the_changed_body`: body b has the stock joints, actuators, bodies, ranges and torque limits; forearms 0.12 m (0.10), ankles 0.33 m below the knee (0.30), elbows 0.78 kg, knees 2.512 kg, 1.52 kg more in all; her reading of its arm 0.554 to 0.573 m and the lane's reach the same; a room-a world of 30 ticks loads onto it (the hand 0.387 to 0.406 m from the shoulder in the same pose) and lives on; a life born on it lives 40 ticks; no scene combines the room change and the body change.
- **The ruler:** at a dawn after the room reading, the life's saved pair carried onto body b (`--body b`): the first day's judged acts, reach_nearer, got, pain and the inverse models' reliability (kappa, the record) against the day before; a body-general brain loses reach on the first morning and gets it back within the day (the cerebellum's and act_inv's re-fit), and its words and its knowledge of the toys stay. The move back the day after is the second reading.
- **Boundary:** an instrument; its dawn after the room's two-day reading.

The nine decisions of the G1 amendment are settled (section 14). These are the environment's remaining shapes, each with the default the design uses until the owner says otherwise. B4, B14 and B18 were answered by the lead for the owner on 2026-09-24 (A37, A38, A40); he may overrule each. On 2026-09-25 B21 was answered by the owner's own word (A61), and B3 by the lead for him (A65).
